description: Sync monday.com webhook events to Jira issues

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key used for monday.com created items

flowVariables.name: ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira issue type created for new monday.com items

flowVariables.name: MONDAY_API_VERSION
flowVariables.instruction: monday.com API version sent in the API-Version header. 2026-07 is the current stable version; see developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/api-versioning

flowVariables.name: MONDAY_BOARD_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Numeric ID of the single monday.com board that mirrors the Jira project

flowVariables.name: MONDAY_JIRA_KEY_COLUMN
flowVariables.instruction: ID of the monday text column holding the linked Jira issue key

flowVariables.name: MONDAY_DESCRIPTION_COLUMN
flowVariables.instruction: ID of the monday long text column holding the Jira description. Must also be replaced in the Update Jira Issue Description condition, which compares a literal column ID.

flowVariables.name: MONDAY_FILES_COLUMN
flowVariables.instruction: ID of the monday files column carrying attachments. Must also be replaced in the Get Monday Asset Public URL condition, which compares a literal column ID.

flowVariables.name: MONDAY_IHUB_USER_ID
flowVariables.instruction: monday.com user ID of the integration user whose token iHub uses. Must also be replaced in the Find Jira Issue by Monday Item ID condition, which compares a literal user ID.

name: Monday Incoming Sync
